your_book:
Jaleel's book posted a solid Monday, with the two largest positions — Abbott (ABT, ~9.8% weight, +2.67% today) and Zoetis (ZTS, ~9.6%, +2.47%) — doing the heavy lifting. NVIDIA (+2.12%) and On Holding (+3.34%) added further lift. Those four names alone account for roughly a third of the book, so their collective bid meaningfully offset the drag from the losers. The book's overall unrealized position remains slightly underwater at −3.14%, so today was a step in the right direction without changing the bigger picture.

The drift problem sits squarely in the healthcare and discretionary names. Boston Scientific (BSX, −13.5% unrealized, STRONG BUY, QARP 81.2) slipped another −0.47% today despite a high-conviction rating — guidance has already been slashed to 7–8.5% growth and management telegraphed flat results through Q3; price and thesis are visibly diverging ahead of the October 28 print. Lululemon (LULU, −27.2% unrealized) dropped another −1.4% with no relief in sight: Americas comps are running −5% for a fifth straight period and the tariff hit to margins isn't reversing. RKLB (−6.8% unrealized, AVOID-rated) shed another −1.22% — it continues to carry an AVOID verdict while occupying a 7.4% weight, which is an unresolved structural mismatch.

Into Tuesday, watch BSX and LULU for any incremental fundamental news, and keep an eye on NVDA: the headline about its market cap outweighing 256 S&P constituents combined is the kind of concentration narrative that can flip sentiment quickly, especially with export-control risk still live ahead of the November 17 report.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated name holds a 7.4% weight — largest unresolved mismatch in the book
attention.note: RKLB is rated AVOID with a QARP of 37.5 yet sits as the 5th-largest position; it fell again today (−1.22%) and the unrealized loss is −6.8%, making the case for trimming or exiting increasingly hard to defer.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed, flat Q3 guided, earnings Oct 28 — price keeps sliding
attention.note: Boston Scientific is −13.5% unrealized and drifting further (−0.47% today) with management already on record guiding flat through Q3; the October 28 print is a binary event that could deepen the loss or reset expectations, and a position-sizing decision is needed before then.

attention.headline: −27.2% unrealized with no catalyst until December 9
attention.note: Five straight quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff-driven margin compression, and a stalled China business leave Lululemon with no near-term fundamental catalyst; the STRONG BUY verdict needs to be stress-tested against the trajectory, not just the valuation.

attention.headline: Record $60B chip deal headline — watch for position-sizing opportunity or volatility
attention.note: The reported $60B Broadcom/Anthropic financing deal is a significant headline for AVGO, but the position is currently only ~1.5% of the book; if the thesis is strengthening, the weight may warrant a fresh look relative to other holdings.
